info.name: Spaceship.com Async Operations Domain Availability API

items.docs: Check domains availability. ### Required Permissions - domains:read ### Rate Limits * The limit to check domains availability is 30 requests per user, within 30 seconds.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name in ASCII format (A-label) whose details are to be fetched. The domain name must be provided in a fully qualified domain format.

items.docs: Check single domain availability. ### Required Permissions - domains:read ### Rate Limits * The limit to check domain availability is 5 requests per domain, within 300 seconds. * The limit to check domain availability is 30 requests per user, within 30 seconds.
